checks.rule.cif_control: The control character of the CIF is valid.

checks.rule.lines_sum: The lines add up to {expected}; the subtotal says {found}.

error.bad_pattern: The file name pattern cannot be empty, start with a dot or hold a slash. Use {name} for the name of the PDF.
error.cannot_open_folder: This computer has no file manager to open the folder with. The files are in {path}.
error.cannot_read_folder: Extract is not allowed to read that folder.
error.cannot_write: Extract could not write the files in {path}: the folder is read-only, full or not allowed. Choose another folder.
error.cannot_write_work: Extract cannot write in its work folder ({path}): it is read-only, full or not allowed. Start Extract again with --work-dir and a folder of yours.
error.edits_would_be_lost: {names}: you have accepted or corrected words in the open copy, and reading it again would lose those changes.
error.engine_load: The text recognition models or the word checker could not be loaded.
error.file_not_readable: This file cannot be read: it is not a file, or this account has no permission to read it.
error.forbidden_token: Refused: wrong or missing token. Open the address printed in the terminal.
error.image_failed: The page image could not be loaded.
error.model_mismatch: The word checker model does not match this version of Extract.
error.name_too_long: That file name is too long for this computer. Use a shorter name pattern.
error.output_exists: A file with that name already exists.
error.password_protected: The PDF is protected by a password.
error.path_outside_home: That folder is outside your home folder.
error.source_changed: The PDF is not the file this document was read from.
error.thorough_model_missing: The thorough mode needs its own guard model file ({path}) and this install does not have it. Switch the second reading to Off or add the file.
error.ui: The interface could not do that.
error.unsupported_file: This file is not a PDF that can be read.
export.warning.unreadable_text_layer: Unreadable pages {pages} still got the few words that were read in the PDF text layer.
guard.fix.engine_alternative: The reader's next best guess for the character {char} (confidence {conf}).
guard.fix.page_vocabulary: The same word is written this way {count} times on the page.
guard.fix.punctuation_restored: Punctuation stuck to the word was separated.
guard.fix.speck_dropped: A speck that is not a word was removed.
guard.fix.word_split: Two words that were run together were split.
guard.fix.words_joined: A word that was cut in pieces was joined.
guard.reason.bad_number_format: The number is not written in a valid way.
guard.reason.low_char_conf: The letter "{char}" was read with low confidence ({conf}).
guard.reason.low_page_quality: The page is of poor quality.
guard.reason.neighbours_unusual: The words around it are unusual too.
guard.reason.unusual_height: Its height is unusual for its line.
guard.reason.unusual_width: Its width is unusual for its length.
guard.warning.fixes_withheld: Page {page}: {share} % of its words would have changed, so no fix was applied here. Check the page by hand.
guard.warning.fixes_withheld_language: Page {page}: no fix was applied here because the language of the page is not one of the Languages you chose, or no word list could judge it. Check the Languages setting, or the page by hand.
guard.warning.locale_assumed: Amounts are assumed to be written in the "{locale}" style.
guard.warning.no_lexicon: No word list for "{language}": words are not compared with a dictionary.
guard.warning.readings_differ: Page {page}: the guard was trained on other second readings ({model}) than the ones the product reads ({product}); the second readings were ignored here.
guard.warning.unscored: Page {page}: {words} words could not be checked ({cause}).
job.warning.same_content: {name} has exactly the same content as {same_as}, which is already open: it is shown once, as {same_as}.
page.reason.few_words: Almost nothing could be read on this page.
page.reason.low_confidence: The text on this page was read with too little confidence.
page.reason.render_failed: The page could not be drawn.
page.warning.low_resolution: Page {page} was scanned at {dpi} dpi, under the 100 dpi Extract needs. It was read as it is, so words may be wrong or missing, and nothing is flagged for that. Check the page, or scan it again at 150 dpi or more.
page.warning.sideways: Page {page}: the lines of text run up or down, so the page is turned a quarter. The words may be right but in the wrong order, or not read at all. Rotate the PDF and read it again.
ui.budget.balanced.hint: A middle way between missed errors and extra checking.
ui.budget.fewer.hint: Flags only the words most likely to be wrong.
ui.budget.more.hint: Flags more words: fewer errors slip through, more to check.
ui.correct.more.hint: Applies more fixes: fewer errors left, a few more fixes to undo.
ui.correct.off.hint: Nothing is changed: the words stay as read and the best fix is only suggested.
ui.correct.safe.hint: Applies only the fixes that almost never break a word.
ui.correct.safe.note: Safe only fixes control digits (DNI/NIE, IBAN); use More for words.
ui.export.note: Nothing is read again: exporting writes your corrections into every file. Existing files are never overwritten.
ui.export.renamed: Some names were already taken, so those files carry -2, -3 and so on. Existing files are never overwritten.
ui.fields.none: This document is not an invoice, so it has no fields.
ui.fields.pick: Click a row to see its word on the page.
ui.fix.undone: You took this fix back; it would have read: {text}.
ui.import.empty: Choose a folder and add the PDFs to read.
ui.import.estimate: Roughly {time} for {pages} pages on this PC; pages full of text take the longer time.
ui.import.estimate_one: Roughly {time} for 1 page on this PC; a page full of text takes the longer time.
ui.import.estimate_typical: Roughly {time} for {pages} pages on a typical laptop; this PC may be slower or faster, and the figure adjusts after your first read. Pages full of text take the longer time.
ui.import.estimate_typical_one: Roughly {time} for 1 page on a typical laptop; this PC may be slower or faster, and the figure adjusts after your first read. A page full of text takes the longer time.
ui.import.where: The folders and files listed here are on the computer that runs Extract, not on the device you are looking at.
ui.mode.label: Corrections
ui.mode.title: Applies to this document and re-applies the fixes without reading again.
ui.read.confirm_replace: {names}: you have accepted or corrected words in the open copy. Reading it again replaces that copy and those changes are lost. Read it again anyway?
ui.read.finished.stopped: Stopped. The documents already read are kept; the one that was being read when you pressed Stop is not, and neither are its pages.
ui.read.review_now: Review what is read so far
ui.read.same_as: Same content as {name}: it opens that document
ui.read.warning_more: The same note applies to {n} more pages: {pages}.
ui.read.warning_more_one: The same note applies to 1 more page: {pages}.
ui.review.crop: The word cut from the page
ui.review.involved: {n} values involved are outlined on the page.
ui.review.involved_one: 1 value involved is outlined on the page.
ui.review.not_checked: not checked: the word checker could not look at this word, so it is not shown as fine.
ui.review.pick: Click a word on the page, or press N for the next doubtful one.
ui.second.failed_doc: Pages without a second reading: {pages}. Their text is the first reading only.
ui.second.failed_page: This page (page {page}) did not get its second reading: the thorough reader needs about 1.6 GB free or went over its limit.
ui.second.gain.more: With More it fixes about {fixed} of every 100 misread words on top of the default model ({language}, measured on the sealed test).
ui.second.gain.other: Its gain is applied with More; with Off or Safe the extra reading is not used to change words.
ui.second.gain.unmeasured: Its gain with this choice of languages has not been measured yet.
ui.second.missing: The reader models of the second reading are not installed here (run python3 scripts/fetch_models.py --all): reading in thorough mode will stop with an error.
ui.second.thorough.detail: Up to about {p95} s on some pages; the reader takes up to {ram} GB of RAM besides the workers.
ui.second.thorough.hint: Thorough mode: re-reads the doubtful lines and zones with a better recogniser: about {seconds} s more per page (measured in development). Needs the reader models (python3 scripts/fetch_models.py --all).
